description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView for displaying log data received via the LogNode interface, including methods for formatting and appending log messages, and chaining LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, capable of formatting log messages and chaining LogNode objects.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, including priority, tag, message, and optional exception, and forwards it to the next LogNode if present.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
